Body.Content:
Azure Event Grid is an innovative offering that will make an event a first-class object in Azure. With Azure Event Grid, you will be able to subscribe to any event that's happening across your Azure resources, and react using serverless platforms like Functions or Logic Apps. In addition to having built-in publishing support for events with services like Blob Storage and Resource Groups, Event Grid will allow you to create your own custom events to publish directly to the service. In addition to having a wide range of Azure services with built-in handlers for events like Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Automation, Event Grid will allow flexibility, supporting custom web hooks to publish events to any service, even third-party services outside of Azure. This flexibility will create endless application options, and make Azure Event Grid a truly unique service in the public cloud. 

Learn more about Azure Event Grid
